description: This PHP source file defines the Jira class within the JiraApi namespace, providing a client interface for interacting with Jira's REST API. It includes methods for user management, issue operations, transitions, comments, and retrieving metadata such as issue types, priorities, versions, and components.

classes.name: Jira
classes.description: A PHP client for Jira REST API providing functionalities to manage issues, users, transitions, comments, and retrieve project metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Jira client with configuration parameters such as host, username, password, proxy and sets up the RestRequest object.

methods.name: configCheck
methods.description: Validates essential configuration parameters such as host, username, and password.

methods.name: testLogin
methods.description: Tests connectivity and authentication with Jira by attempting to retrieve the current user's details.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username from Jira.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email address from Jira.

methods.name: getMyself
methods.description: Retrieves the details of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Fetches all issue statuses from Jira.

methods.name: getTransitions
methods.description: Gets available status transitions for a specific issue.

methods.name: getChangelog
methods.description: Retrieves change logs for an issue, optionally as text.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Fetches comments on a specific issue.

methods.name: queryIssue
methods.description: Executes a JQL query to search for issues.

methods.name: createIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Jira with specified fields.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds an attachment file to an issue.

methods.name: updateIssue
methods.description: Updates an existing issue with provided fields.

methods.name: transitionIssue
methods.description: Transitions an issue to a new status.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to an issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue.

methods.name: checkUserPermissionsForProject
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific permissions on a project.

methods.name: getIssueTypes
methods.description: Gets available issue types.

methods.name: getPriorities
methods.description: Gets available issue priorities.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves project versions.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves project components.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches project details by project key.

methods.name: getCreateIssueFields
methods.description: Retrieves issue types and fields metadata for creating issues for specified projects.

methods.name: getCreateIssueMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for creating issues, possibly filtered by project keys and options.
